name: Brains: Schatzkarte
summary: Solo tile-placement puzzle by Reiner Knizia where you reassemble a treasure map to find a continuous path.
rules_text: Each puzzle gives a frame and a set of map tiles to place inside. Every tile shows path segments, blocked spaces, and symbols like start, treasure, and landmarks. You must place all tiles, no overlap, no rotation beyond allowed, to create one continuous path from the start to the treasure that respects printed clues. Some tiles are fixed, others must be deduced. Clues may require the path to pass or not pass certain points, or to have exact length. You solve level by level with increasing difficulty, checking your solution against the solution in the booklet.
rating_reason: Only title and author, insufficient rules
